messages:
elaine_csm: Quick sync — EduHealth sent back a vendor risk pack and a DPA with a few open items. They want confirmation on SOC2 scope (prod only vs prod+staging), KMS/HSM support, and whether embeddings can be pinned to a specific region. Onboarding kickoff is next Monday, so we need answers before Friday.

jordan_onboard: noted. Do we have a template response we can reuse for KMS details? their security team is asking for key lifecycle docs.

raj_security: we have KMS FAQ + key-rotation policy. Short answer: yes, we support customer-managed keys in Private and Dedicated; hosted API uses Redwood-managed keys but can be integrated with partner KMS for enterprise—will paste snippet. :mag:

raj_security: ```
KMS support summary:
- Private: customer KMS/HSM (bring-your-own) via KMS integration + HSM on-prem options
- Dedicated: optional customer KMS for long-term keys; envelope encryption supported
- Hosted: Redwood-managed keys by default; enterprise accounts can request KMS bridge (SLA & legal review)
```

mira_legal: for the DPA they flagged two clauses: subprocessor list and data residency assurances. We should avoid promising "on-prem" unless ops has deployed Private. Can we confirm current Private deployment for EduHealth? Also they'll need SOC2 Type II report redacted — CS to send link to evidence portal.

elaine_csm: @jordan_onboard we don't have Private deployed for them yet — customer asked during sales call as potential requirement if they move to prod. For now we should respond with hosting options + migration path. I'll send the SOC2 redacted PDF via secure link.

jordan_onboard: ok I'll draft a clear reply: 1) SOC2: prod-scope by default, can extend to staging with ent. 2) KMS: paste raj snippet + attach rotation policy 3) embeddings residency: list regions and recommended Dedicated/Private for strict residency 4) timeline for Private onboarding if needed (4–6 weeks).

elaine_csm: + ask them to indicate which data types they consider "sensitive" in the form — that affects our recommended deployment. Also flag potential renewal risk: if they require Private for launch we should loop in AM and ops for capacity and legal for contract amendments. :warning:

dpa-bot: New doc uploaded to secure portal: /secure/evidence/eduhealth/soc2_redacted_2025-02.pdf (expires in 7 days) :lock:

raj_security: small addendum — for embeddings residency, call out that inference may still touch global cache unless using Dedicated with residency enforcement. Recommend we offer an interim mitigation: prefix filtering + policy to keep KV cache local.

mira_legal: I'll prepare language for the subprocessor list and a short note on how we handle DPA amendments for Private deployments. Elaine — can you confirm the customer contact and deadline?

elaine_csm: contact is laura@eduhealth.com, they asked for responses by Friday EOD. I'll attach the risk form they returned and the questionnaire answers so Jordan can reference them.

jordan_onboard: draft ready, pushing to thread in 30 min. Action items: Elaine will upload SOC2 link & risk form; Raj to attach KMS FAQ + rotation policy; Mira to draft DPA amendment language; Jordan to send consolidated reply to laura@eduhealth.com by Fri EOD. :white_check_mark:
